Name: Amasa, Son of Jether
Summary: Amasa, son of Jether, had been Absalom's captain and then David's; in Kings he is named with Abner as one of the two captains Joab slew in peacetime.
KeyStory: Amasa named among Joab's peacetime victims.
RelatedPeople: King David; Joab, Son of Zeruiah; Abner, Son of Ner; Jether, Father of Amasa
LifeLesson: Changing sides does not change the danger of trusting the wrong commander.
